components.name: Plate Button
components.description: The default control: a brass-edged plate that inverts when pressed and is hatched when unaffordable.
components.css: .ds-plate { min-height: 44px; padding: 4px 14px; border: 1px solid #d8a94e; border-radius: 2px; background: #0a1020; color: #ece3cc; font: 12px Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: .06em; display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; transition: background-color .12s ease-out, color .12s ease-out; cursor: pointer; } .ds-plate b { font-weight: normal; font-size: 15px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-plate:hover:not(:disabled) { background: rgba(216,169,78,.12); } .ds-plate:active:not(:disabled) { background: #d8a94e; color: #0a1020; } .ds-plate:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #f0c874; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-plate:disabled { border-color: rgba(226,214,186,.22); color: #7f7763; background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(226,214,186,.10) 0 1px, transparent 1px 5px); cursor: default; }

components.name: Primary Plate
components.description: Solid brass, once per screen: Wind the sky, Collect.
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height: 50px; padding: 0 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 2px; background: #d8a94e; color: #0a1020; font: 16px Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: .08em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary:active { background: #f0c874; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #f0c874; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Deck Tabs
components.description: Four equal tabs; the active one carries a brass rule, a brass dot marks news.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); background: #0a1020; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(226,214,186,.1); } .ds-tabs button { min-height: 42px; border: 0; background: none; color: #b8ad93; font: 13px Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: .06em; position: relative; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tabs button.on { color: #ece3cc; } .ds-tabs button.on::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 22%; right: 22%; bottom: 0; height: 2px; background: #d8a94e; } .ds-tabs i { display: inline-block; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #d8a94e; margin-left: 5px; vertical-align: 2px; } .ds-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #f0c874; outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Gear Dial
components.description: Chevrons around a toothed knob showing the ring's gear as p:q.
components.html: 3:2
components.css: .ds-dial { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; background: #0a1020; padding: 6px; } .ds-dial button { width: 40px; height: 44px; border: 0; background: none; color: #d8a94e; display: grid; place-items: center; cursor: pointer; } .ds-dial button:active { color: #f0c874; } .ds-knob { width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid #d8a94e; outline: 3px dotted rgba(216,169,78,.55); outline-offset: -5px; background: #0e1729; color: #ece3cc; display: grid; place-items: center; font: 12px Georgia, serif; }

components.css: .ds-obs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 34px 1fr; gap: 8px; padding: 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(226,214,186,.14); border-radius: 2px; background: #0a1020; color: #ece3cc; font-family: Georgia, serif; max-width: 220px; } .ds-seal { width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%; border: 3px double #d8a94e; color: #f0c874; display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 11px; } .ds-obs h4 { font-weight: normal; font-size: 13.5px; margin: 0; } .ds-obs p { font-size: 11.5px; color: #b8ad93; margin: 2px 0 0; } .ds-obs em { font-style: normal; font-size: 11px; color: #d8a94e; }

narrative.overview: Clockwork Sky is a brass orrery drawn in fine engraving lines on a night-ink ground. Every control is a part of the mechanism: a winding key, a mainspring gauge, gear dials, a forecast track. Motion comes only from the machine turning.
keyCharacteristics: Engraved cream lines at low alpha
One brass accent for everything mechanical
Roman plate lettering with wide tracking

rules.name: One brass
rules.body: Brass is the only accent for controls; a new control never brings a new color.

rules.name: Vermilion is earned
rules.body: Vermilion appears only for line-ups of four or more and an overloaded spring.

rules.name: Press inverts, poor is hatched
rules.body: Pressed plates invert to brass; unaffordable controls wear the engraving hatch.

dos: Draw sky elements as lines or flat tints with hatch shading
Show state through the control itself
donts: No glows or drop shadows on controls
The system serif is a constraint, not an ideal
